module.name: AI-Mail / S.I.A. Mail
module.baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending

epics.asset_contract: preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access
epics.target_outcome: Verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records
epics.failure_invariant: Central login cannot read unrelated mailbox

epics.asset_contract: UIDVALIDITY, cursor, pagination, attachments and dedupe
epics.target_outcome: Reconcile incrementally synced mailbox with provider state
epics.failure_invariant: UID rollover does not duplicate entire history

epics.asset_contract: thread summarization, draft provenance and user consent
epics.target_outcome: Produce grounded draft with human send approval
epics.failure_invariant: Prompt content cannot trigger silent send

epics.asset_contract: quarantine, MIME validation, malware flags and data rights
epics.target_outcome: Reject malicious attachment before AI ingestion

epics.asset_contract: read/fetch/send status, error cluster, test proof and SLAs
epics.target_outcome: Show user attributable mailbox event and retry evidence
epics.failure_invariant: No private message body leaked to analytics

tasks.title: Establish ground-truth baseline: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Inventory existing repository, database tables, Edge/server functions, Vercel routes, service owners and policy boundaries for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access. Compare verified runtime behavior to the declared capability; mark anything untested or illustrative.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dated baseline identifies actual versus simulated state for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access, accountable owner, commit SHA, environment, contract gaps and threat paths; it explicitly notes: Central login cannot read unrelated mailbox.
tasks.negative_test: Confirm 3 sampled claims against live read-only source IDs; produce a negative evidence case showing that central login cannot read unrelated mailbox.
tasks.source_baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending
tasks.palantir_capability: Data Connection: incremental, batch, CDC, streams
tasks.reviewer_role: Independent technical/security reviewer + designated module owner

tasks.title: Specify versioned engineering contract: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Specify versioned types and API for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access: tenant/entity, Mission ID, principal, region, classification, purpose, rights/license, event time, TTL, approval scope, idempotency and error states. Define explicit non-goals and interoperability with upstream/downstream modules.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: JSON Schema/OpenAPI and migration proposal validate golden examples for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access; implementation plan leads to: Verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records. No unreviewed access or irreversible change is implied.
tasks.negative_test: Schema validator rejects missing ownership, changed action parameters and central login cannot read unrelated mailbox.
tasks.source_baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending
tasks.palantir_capability: Data Connection: incremental, batch, CDC, streams
tasks.reviewer_role: Independent technical/security reviewer + designated module owner

tasks.title: Implement gated vertical slice: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Implement the minimum testable mailbox ownership mapping capability for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access in an allowlisted sandbox or reviewed preview; bind inputs to typed source contracts, real permission checks and immutable audit references. Build only the route necessary to demonstrate: Verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Isolated feature branch contains code, migration and operator-visible status for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access; sample transaction proves verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records without unapproved external side effects.
tasks.negative_test: Feature defaults disabled, environment isolation holds, and central login cannot read unrelated mailbox.
tasks.source_baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending
tasks.palantir_capability: Data Connection: incremental, batch, CDC, streams
tasks.reviewer_role: Independent technical/security reviewer + designated module owner

tasks.title: Run positive, negative and adversarial tests: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Build deterministic happy-path, failure, replay, concurrency, stale-data, tenant-isolation and privilege-boundary tests for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access. Include prompt-injection or provider spoofing when the surface processes untrusted content.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Automated acceptance suite passes in isolated runner against real schema; test report independently establishes: Verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records; unresolved failures are explicit blockers.
tasks.negative_test: Include at least one executable regression asserting: Central login cannot read unrelated mailbox. Assert no write or external side effect on denied request.
tasks.source_baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending
tasks.palantir_capability: Data Connection: incremental, batch, CDC, streams
tasks.reviewer_role: Independent technical/security reviewer + designated module owner

tasks.title: Instrument evidence, SLOs and unit economics: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Instrument preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access with trace_id, mission_id, source/version, policy evaluation, status, latency P50/P95, error counts, spend/quotas, freshness, operator owner and outcome quality. Record sampling/redaction and measurement windows.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dashboard or trace can distinguish success, failure and indeterminate for preserve IMAP identities, credentials, folder rights and delegated access; named metric owners approve thresholds; evidence connects to target: Verify existing account can reconnect without new duplicate records.
tasks.negative_test: Inject a simulated failure, stale observation and quota breach; metrics emit correct signal while preventing: central login cannot read unrelated mailbox.
tasks.source_baseline: L2: mailbox synchronization capability and central login, user acceptance pending
tasks.palantir_capability: Data Connection: incremental, batch, CDC, streams
tasks.reviewer_role: Independent technical/security reviewer + designated module owner

tasks.title: Prepare independent release and rollback packet: Mailbox ownership mapping
tasks.instructions: Assemble decision packet for mailbox ownership mapping: precise source SHA, contracts, security test results, data-rights evidence, rollback plan, reviewer identity and cost; submit to independent authorized human via Crucible/MANDATE. Do not execute release from SPIRE.
